events.title: An earthquake shakes Constantinople and weakens Hagia Sophia
events.description: A powerful earthquake damaged much of Constantinople and cracked the great dome of Hagia Sophia, which collapsed the following May. It was rebuilt higher and rededicated in 562.

events.title: Emperor Wenzong's plot against the palace eunuchs fails
events.description: Emperor Wenzong of Tang and the chancellor Li Xun planned to lure the palace eunuchs to view sweet dew, an auspicious omen, and kill them. The eunuchs discovered the ambush, and their troops killed the chancellors and many officials.

events.title: Nostradamus is born in Saint-Rémy-de-Provence
events.description: Michel de Nostredame, physician and astrologer, was born in Provence. His Prophecies of 1555, written in vague rhymed quatrains, have been claimed as predictions of countless later events.

events.title: The Theresian Military Academy is founded at Wiener Neustadt
events.description: The Theresian Military Academy was founded in the castle of Wiener Neustadt in Lower Austria, once a residence of Emperor Frederick III. The Austrian Armed Forces still train their officers there.
events.html: The Theresian Military Academy was founded in the castle of Wiener Neustadt in Lower Austria, once a residence of Emperor Frederick III. The Austrian Armed Forces still train their officers there.

events.title: Alexander Hamilton marries Elizabeth Schuyler in Albany
events.description: Alexander Hamilton, who served as George Washington's aide in the Revolutionary War, married Elizabeth Schuyler at the Schuyler Mansion in Albany, New York. From 1789 he was the first secretary of the treasury.
events.html: Alexander Hamilton, who served as George Washington's aide in the Revolutionary War, married Elizabeth Schuyler at the Schuyler Mansion in Albany, New York. From 1789 he was the first secretary of the treasury.

events.title: George Washington dies at Mount Vernon
events.description: George Washington died aged 67 after a throat infection, worsened by heavy bloodletting. Having twice given up power, as commander and as president, he was mourned as the father of his country.

events.title: Max Planck presents the quantum hypothesis
events.description: Before the German Physical Society in Berlin, Max Planck proposed that energy is emitted in discrete packets, or quanta. The idea, introduced to solve a problem in heat radiation, became the basis of quantum physics.

events.title: Roald Amundsen's party reaches the South Pole
events.description: Norwegian explorer Roald Amundsen and four companions became the first people to reach the South Pole. Robert Falcon Scott's British party arrived 34 days later to find the Norwegian tent and flag.
